Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Mathieu wrote:
>
> Just to be sure: if a minion takes an action, is blocked, and plays
> superior Form of Mist, do previous action modifiers still apply
> (including previous stealth mods & sup. Forms of Mist)?

Yes.
Note that if this minion can played a superior Form of Mist already
this action, he cannot play another at superior, since the superior
counts as an action modifier and cannot be played twice by the same
minion in the same action.

> > counts as an action modifier and cannot be played twice by the same

>

> What if he played Form of Mist..then Mask of Thousand Faces and a new
> Form of Mist with that new vampire? It's not the same vampire..but it
> shouldn't be allowed stills icne an action modifier can't be used to
> modify an action in the exact same way, more than once. But I want to
> be sure :)

There is no such restriction - the restriction is per minion, so the
above (Mist - Mask - Mist) scenario is legal.

You can also play superior Cloak The Gathering with as many
ready minions as you control that have superior Obfuscate to
give the acting minion +1 stealth.
